identity.kind: water storage drum (plastic), food-grade claim not verifiable from photos

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: Photos show a blue plastic drum but no readable food-grade marking, certification, or label; no proof of single-use.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No close-up of seams/gasket and no leak test shown; photos do not confirm leak-free condition.
General statement; not supported by specific, verifiable details in the photos.

risks.risk: Food-grade status may be untrue (could be non-food plastic or previously used for other chemicals).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of any embossed/printed markings on the drum (e.g., food-grade/HDPE code) and any label/certificate from the supplier.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven food-grade (worst case for buyer).

risks.risk: Leak risk at lid gasket, bung/cap, or side seam not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a water-fill/leak test (fill to near top, show no dripping for a few minutes) or a pressure/soak test clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/needs checking (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Cracks could exist on the bottom or underside, not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the bottom and the full circumference (including underside) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may have hidden cracks (worst case: assume damage risk).

risks.risk: Capacity/size unknown from photos; price depends heavily on volume.
risks.proof: Ask for the exact capacity marking (liters/gallons) or a tape-measure/height+diameter measurement photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely size bracket for this type until capacity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of any embossed/printed food-grade/HDPE markings and any label on the drum (not seller text).
Video proof of a leak test: fill with water and show no dripping around lid, bung/cap, and seams for several minutes.
Photos of the bottom/underside and side seams in bright light to check for hidden cracks.
Exact drum capacity (liters/gallons) shown on the drum or measured (height and diameter).
response.reason: The photos show a plastic water drum, but key factors that determine safe use and price—food-grade proof, leak-free confirmation, and capacity—are not verifiable from the provided images.
